tara: Starting staged deployment for auth-proxy v1.8.0 -> 5% (canary). change window 20:00-21:00 PT. Requesting stop/go.

deploy-bot: [automated] Rollout started: auth-proxy@v1.8.0 -> 5% (region: us-east-1). rollout_id=rl-20260505-03. To pause: `deployctl pause rl-20260505-03`.

ben: SLIs to watch: 5xx, p99, oauth latency, token-issuance errors. rollback if 5xx > 1% for 3m or p99 > 800ms for 5m.

yusuf: confirm config: token-cache ttl reduced in this build (30s->10s). risk: cache churn causing backend auth spikes.

tara: noted. can we route canary to internal-only cohort first?

deploy-bot: routing updated: header x-team=="internal" -> 100% canary; default -> 5%.

ben: seeing initial metrics @ +6m: requests=7.8k/min, 5xx=0.12%, p99=95ms. token-issue errors=0. No alerts.

pagerduty: standing by. will page if threshold breached.

tara: quick vote to go to 25% at 20:25 PT. react :thumbsup: to go, say hold to stop. 20s.

ben: :thumbsup: go.

yusuf: :thumbsup: go, will keep eye on token churn.

deploy-bot: [automated] Rollout update: scaled to 25% at 20:25 PT. rollout_id=rl-20260505-03. Next checkpoint @20:40 PT.
